in_hebrew.name: Morry
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Morry הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘Maurus’, meaning ‘Moor’ or ‘Dark-skinned’. Morry may have been a popular name among the early Christian communities in the Mediterranean region, where people with darker complexions were common.
